research_question: On the nine real H7H Kornia symbol/configuration units, does frozen EffectV7 retain a safety, coverage, auditability, or total-cost advantage over stateful black-box and public-source-guided greybox dynamic baselines?
claim_boundary: Posthoc method calibration on already-known H7H source and oracle. Results cannot be reported as a new blind holdout.

policies.dynamic_blackbox: Receives the public unit configuration and runnable operator factory but does not inspect source or oracle.
policies.dynamic_source_guided: Receives the same runtime evidence plus public symbol/source/MRO; it may conservatively reject unresolved Sequential child delegation using a predeclared generic container heuristic.
policies.effect_v7_frozen: Reuses the frozen H7H analyzer, adapter and validator without modification.
policies.manual_full: Uses one complete decision/reason hint per unit as an oracle upper bound, not a deployable automatic method.

fairness: Dynamic policies use identical factories, prepared params, inputs, warmup, budgets and max-call limits.
The greybox policy may inspect public source but not expected decision or coarse reason.
EffectV7 predictions are produced before the H7H expected fields are joined for scoring.
Shared package-index and runtime-factory setup are reported separately from per-unit latency.
Crash, timeout and unknown remain in the denominator.
burden_accounting: EffectV7 adapter rule count and adapter LOC
greybox semantic guidance rule count and guidance LOC
runtime factory entries and factory LOC
primary_outputs: TP/FP/FN/TN and safe recall by policy and budget
per-unit and shared setup wall time
falsification_rules: If source-guided dynamic matches EffectV7 decisions and reasons with fewer semantic rules and comparable total cost, C1 detection-accuracy novelty is weak.
If black-box dynamic matches EffectV7, source analysis is not justified on this scope.
If EffectV7 wins only by treating all containers as unknown, report the coverage/scope limitation rather than a universal safety advantage.
